title: POPANE-R6 Metric and Trajectory-Tracking Sensitivity
classification: Post-primary statistical/interpretive sensitivity. POPANE-R1 MAE outcomes are known.
purpose: Test whether persistence dominance is specific to absolute-error scoring, or whether physiology may better track future valence trajectories despite worse MAE.
reuse_from_r1: Identical technical QC, anchors, targets and physiology features.
Identical deterministic subject folds and simultaneous held-person × held-segment training exclusion.
Identical naive prediction = prior_affect; context = prior_affect + time_norm; physiology = context + all R1 physiology features.
Identical Ridge tuning and HGB hyperparameters.

metrics.MAE: Retain only as a consistency check with R1.
metrics.RMSE: Tests sensitivity to larger errors; lower is better.
metrics.CCC: Lin concordance correlation coefficient between predictions and future valence; higher is better and is widely used in continuous-affect evaluation.

uncertainty.method: Resample usable participants with replacement. Reconstruct the corresponding out-of-fold prediction rows with subject multiplicity and recompute pooled RMSE and CCC for each model.
contrasts: delta_rmse_context_phys = RMSE(context)-RMSE(physiology); positive favors physiology beyond context.
delta_ccc_phys_naive = CCC(physiology)-CCC(naive); positive favors physiology trajectory concordance.
delta_ccc_phys_context = CCC(physiology)-CCC(context); positive favors physiology beyond context.

decisions.METRIC_ROBUST_PERSISTENCE_DOMINANCE: For all four horizons and both learners, delta_rmse_naive_phys 95% CI is strictly below zero AND no delta_ccc_phys_naive 95% CI is strictly above zero.
decisions.PHYSIOLOGY_TRACKING_RESCUE: At least one horizon has BOTH Ridge and HGB delta_ccc_phys_naive 95% CIs strictly above zero, even if MAE/RMSE remain worse. Manuscript must distinguish point-error utility from trajectory concordance.
decisions.MODEL_SPECIFIC_TRACKING_SIGNAL: At least one CCC physiology-vs-naive CI is strictly above zero but the same horizon is not positive for both learners.

firewalls: Post-primary sensitivity; does not replace R1 MAE inference.
CCC improvement would indicate better concordant tracking, not causal physiological necessity.
Null CCC/RMSE sensitivity does not prove physiology has no information under other representations.
paper_role: Determine whether the central result is robust beyond MAE and whether physiology may track temporal variation better despite worse absolute forecasts.
